## Must-haves
Category listing: header region (breadcrumb, h1 from the category name, intro from the content map when the slug is known, chip row of sub-needs linking to child categories or filtered URLs), filter button opening the engine filters in a drawer at 390 and a sidebar at 1024+, result count and sort, product grid using the registry card (2 columns at 390, 4 at 1440), load-more button (never infinite scroll), FAQ accordion from the content map, ItemList and FAQPage JSON-LD via `withHead` extend (single declaration each; the engine emits BreadcrumbList already), canonical with the locale prefix. Goal landing (`goal-*` slugs): the same route, hero band with the display h1 and intro, sub-needs cards, the product grid, FAQ, need-help CTA linking to `/services`. Search: wrapper with the zero-results state from FINAL-content 6.5 (chips linking to categories and goals), `robots: noindex`. Brands: styled grid. Offers, latest, most-sales, tags: the same ListingPage. Everything keyed by slug at runtime; no hardcoded category ids.

## Claims gates (binding)
No popularity claims in listing chrome ("الأكثر مبيعا" only as the engine's own sort label if it exists; no invented badges); no shipping threshold text except through `{threshold}` from `free_shipping_threshold`; no reply-time promise; no health outcome language in chips, intros or FAQ (the content maps were audited; do not add copy of your own, use `TODO-copy:` placeholders for anything missing).
